scope: Isolated v3 research only; this is not a production security claim.

entries.evidence: Canonical room/password encoding and deterministic RFC 9380 query tests.
Same room with different passwords derives distinct opaque rendezvous tags and separate relay rooms.
Different rooms with the same password derive distinct opaque rendezvous tags and separate relay rooms.
Canonical credential framing preserves leading zeroes, so 0 and 00 remain distinct.
Canonical credential framing accepts both 1-digit and 128-digit room/password boundaries.
Empty and 129-digit inputs are rejected locally before any threshold or relay action.

RFC 9380 query plus the frozen OPRF-output fixture, HKDF, prologue and synthetic confirmation transcript agree in Rust, Node, Chrome, Edge and Firefox; Web does not independently execute TACEO/Poseidon2 or Noise, and Android remains deferred.
Authenticated ACK removes only its matching pending message; invalid ACKs fail closed.
Authenticated BURN is terminal and clears pending messages, role, responses, and modeled key state.
Timeout terminates the modeled session and clears all provisional state.
Reversed role-nonce views produce different Noise prologues and fail the handshake.
An initiator rejects reflection of its own first Noise flight.
Mismatched epochs and transcript-bound nonce views fail the Noise handshake.
Replayed sequence numbers and responses from another epoch fail closed.
Invalid or mismatched OPRF proofs are rejected; a malleated encrypted share produces a bound, substantiated complaint and terminal cleanup before Ready.
Operator responses and ceremony messages from different manifests cannot be combined.
Registration is impossible before the required number of distinct operator responses is reached.
A third participant invalidates the complete provisional pair and clears its queued state.
The relay API accepts only an opaque epoch/tag key, but metadata leakage and deployment behavior still require network validation.
Fresh blindings produce different OPRF requests while finalizing to the same credential-bound output.
Timing and IP correlation by an operator plus relay remain visible metadata; the design makes no anonymity claim.
A fully malicious threshold quorum can evaluate guesses; this trust compromise is explicit and unresolved.
Manifest and epoch mismatch fail closed locally; authenticated manifest distribution and downgrade resistance remain unresolved.
Mixed-epoch responses and rotated ceremony material are rejected in the state and ceremony models.
Truncated Noise frames, duplicate protocol messages, and oversized relay frames are rejected.
Unavailable randomness aborts before any operator response is accepted or key state becomes active.
